subject: Service continuity: runbook transfer & subscription sync with PagerSafe
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@pagersafe.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Upcoming subscription renewal & runbook migration support

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — quick heads up that your PagerSafe subscription is up for renewal on 2025-05-31 (account: Redwood Inference). I pulled the renewal quote and included it here as a starting point (attachment: PagerSafe_Renewal_Quote_20250418.pdf).

We’ve also seen a few customers request help migrating on-call runbooks and escalation policies when they renew so they don’t lose history or incident routing during cutover. If Redwood would like, our Technical Ops team can do a runbook export/import and validate routing for the first 30 services as part of a migration add-on. Rough outline:
- Export existing escalation policies and schedules
- Convert to PagerSafe policy schema
- Validate webhooks & integrations (Slack, Ops hooks)
- Dry-run promotions in a staging org

If this is of interest, I can introduce you to the engineering lead and share a short SOW. Also happy to add a 30-day overlap window in the quote so you can keep both systems in sync during migration.

Attach: PagerSafe_Renewal_Quote_20250418.pdf

Best,
Lina Park
Account Executive, PagerSafe

Date: 2025-04-19T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming subscription renewal & runbook migration support

Neha — I reviewed the PagerSafe quote. High level commercial notes:
- Base renewal (1-year, enterprise plan): matches current spend + a ~4% list increase (they offered a level-term option at the same $ if we commit 24 months).
- Migration add-on: PagerSafe lists a fixed fee of $18,500 for the 30-day overlap + up to 30 runbooks. Additional runbooks billed at $600/runbook.
- We can probably negotiate the one-time fee down if we commit to 24 months and give them a single POV engineer for the export tasks.

Procurement path: Laura — if pricing looks OK, we need a PO for the renewal amount + migration add-on flagged as a one-time professional services line. I’ll attach quick notes with negotiation levers.

Attach: redwood-pricing-notes-20250419.txt

Recommendation: pursue a 12-month renewal with a negotiated migration credit (aiming for $12k fixed fee or a cap of 20 runbooks). If SRE confirms fewer than 20 runbooks require conversion, we have negotiating room.

Marcus
VP, Cloud Platform — Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-21T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming subscription renewal & runbook migration support

Thanks for the ping. I pulled a quick inventory of high-priority runbooks and escalation pathways. Summary:
- Total runbooks: 42 (15 are low-touch archival; 27 are active — of which 9 are multi-service escalation flows).
- Priority migration set: 18 runbooks covering our top 25 services (SLO-attached). These are the ones that must have identical routing & notification windows during cutover.
- Integrations: Slack and our internal webhook handlers are standard; PagerSafe’s webhook format is different but trivial to adapt with a small shim (estimate 2 engineer-days).
- SSO/KMS: they support SAML and can integrate to our IdP; KMS key usage is via envelope encryption and requires a short compliance review (1 day).

Effort estimate for migration (technical):
- Export + mapping: 5 engineer-days (two infra engineers 3 days, one infra lead 2 days)
- Integration testing & dry runs in staging: 4 engineer-days
- Cutover support (overlap period monitoring): 3 engineer-days (on-call rotation coverage)
- Project coordination & runbook validation: 4 PM/Eng days

Total: ~16 engineer-days over a 2–3 week window. If PagerSafe insists on per-runbook fees, we should negotiate a capped price for the priority 18.

Blocking items for timeline:
- A signed SOW that defines rollout phases and a staging window (they mentioned a 30-day overlap in their note).
- PO/contracting to ensure PS work can start (PagerSafe needs a purchase order or a signed DocuSign).

I’ll update the attached scope sheet with the runbook list and owners by EOD.

Evelyn Hart
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@pagersafe.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-25T14:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming subscription renewal & runbook migration support

Lina — thanks for the quote and for offering migration support. We’d like to proceed on the following path:

1) Commercial: aim for a 12-month renewal and a negotiated migration fixed fee capped at $12,000 covering up to 20 priority runbooks (PagerSafe to confirm).
2) Technical: SRE has prioritized 18 runbooks for the first phase and estimates ~16 engineer-days for work + staging dry runs.
3) Contracting: please send a DocuSign with the renewal + an attached SOW that clearly defines the 30-day overlap window and acceptance criteria for migrated runbooks. HubSpot Deal ID DEAL-2025-047 should be on the PO.

Laura — once Lina sends the DocuSign, can you route to procurement and book a PO? Marcus — please stand by for a negotiated credit if Lina can confirm the cap. Evelyn — please coordinate with Lina’s ops lead to schedule the dry run week (we’ll target the first week after signature).

Thanks all — looking to close this by EOW next week if possible.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
